title: Forensic Photo - Tamper-Evident Cash Bag Seal/ID Notation Detail (EV005)
prompt:
1) Function: Capture a forensic-quality close-up photograph documenting the tamper-evident cash bag seal and handwritten ID notation for identification and comparison.
2) Scene / Composition: A single tamper-evident cash bag seal area lies flat on a clean, matte, neutral-gray evidence bench surface with diffuse lab background out of focus. The frame is tightly composed so the seal and handwritten ID notation occupy ~70% of the frame, with the bag material texture clearly visible. A small forensic scale (metric, L-shaped) is placed adjacent to the seal without covering any writing, aligned parallel to frame edges. A minimal, non-identifying annotation arrow and text label overlays point to the handwritten ID notation and the seal closure edge, without adding any case number or evidence ID in-image.
3) Angle & Distance: 90° top-down angle; distance_m=0.38.
4) Optics & Technique: 60 mm macro lens; aperture f/11; shutter 1/160 s; ISO 200; white balance 5600 K; flash-lit (forensic-style on-camera flash with diffuser) for even illumination; focus locked on the handwritten notation plane; deep DOF across seal and adjacent scale.
5) Mandatory elements: Visible tamper-evident seal closure edge; handwritten ID notation on the bag material adjacent to the seal; metric forensic scale in-frame; simple annotation (arrow + short label) highlighting the ID notation and seal edge.
6) Negatives: No faces, people, hands, fingerprints, or body parts; no real names, no brands or logos; no official badges or agency seals; no readable addresses, phone numbers, bank names, or account numbers; no license plates; no caseId or evidenceId text inside the image; no additional documents, receipts, or unrelated items; no harsh directional shadows, glare hotspots, or blown highlights.
7) Acceptance checklist: - Top-down 90° view with edges of objects parallel to frame.
- Seal closure edge and handwritten ID notation are sharp and legible.
- Metric forensic scale is present and not obscuring writing.
- Annotation arrow/text is present, minimal, and contains no case/evidence identifiers.
- Lighting is even, flash-based, color-neutral, with no strong glare.
- No prohibited entities (faces, brands, real names, official insignia) appear.
